name: i18n catalog pipeline: POT/PO/MO plus JS JSON
query: This plugin is for Iranian sites. The admin UI must appear in Persian. PHP notices use esc_html_e() and a React settings panel already wraps labels with __() from @wordpress/i18n. Add fa_IR translations.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route via wordpress-router; apply wp-dev-standards for i18n/string rules
Step 2: Keep every gettext / wp.i18n / @wordpress/i18n source string in English — do not put Persian inside __(), _e(), esc_html_e(), or JS __()
Step 3: Run wp i18n make-pot from the plugin root into languages/{text-domain}.pot
Step 4: Create languages/{text-domain}-fa_IR.po (copy from POT) or wp i18n update-po if a PO already exists; set Language: fa_IR and Plural-Forms
Step 5: Fill msgstr in the PO with Persian; leave msgid in English; do not invent extra msgid entries
Step 6: Run wp i18n make-mo languages so PHP can load {text-domain}-fa_IR.mo
Step 7: Because JS strings exist, run wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge (add --use-map if build path differs from source path)
Step 8: Ensure the script has a wp-i18n dependency and wp_set_script_translations( handle, domain, filesystem languages path ) after register; JS uses __ / _x / _n / _nx / sprintf only (no _e)
Step 9: Wire load_plugin_textdomain on init (not plugins_loaded); Domain Path /languages
success_criteria: No Persian (or other non-English) literals inside gettext or @wordpress/i18n / wp.i18n calls
languages/{domain}.pot exists and was generated with make-pot
languages/{domain}-fa_IR.po exists with Language: fa_IR and filled msgstr; msgid remains English
Jed JSON exists for JS sources (make-json --no-purge), named {domain}-fa_IR-{md5}.json or {domain}-fa_IR-{handle}.json
wp-i18n dependency + wp_set_script_translations after the script is registered
Target language comes from catalogs, not from PHP/JS source strings
